title: Ruuh bu ñuy sonal ci Nile bi
intro: Ci jamonoy noot gu metti, jamonoy jaay doole di jiite réew mi ak fitna gu mat sëkk, kenn ci ñoom tànn yoonu ngëm moo gën dundu bànneexu buur. Nit ki dëkkoon ci xol bu am doole, waaye gis dëgg ci bataaxalu yonent bu woyof. Seen tukki dina nekk njàngale budul jeex ci muñ, joxe bàkkan, ak gëm gu sax. Ndax mën nga ràññee nit ku yéeme ki gënoon bëgg bànneexu Yàlla moo gën nekk àdduna?
clues: Maa ngi dëkkoon ci palaasu buur bu mag, waaye sama xol gis dëgg ci bataaxal bu woyof.
Ma tànn topp ndigalu Musaa, ndax xamoon naa lima nara dal.
Maa ngi sëyoon ak ki gënoon am doole ci sama jamono, waaye ma bañ yàllam yu baaxul yi.
Sama tiis mettiwoon na lool, ndax dañu ma yar ndax gëmoon naa benn Yàlla.
Musu ma xàddi ci sama ngëm, doonte daa jànkoonte ak fitna bu metti.
Sama Boroom bég na ci sama muñ, tànn ma barab bu tedd ci Aljanna.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Xeex ci yoonu Yàlla ak larme
Di jàkkarloo ak Firawna, di fësal ngëm
Tabax barabi jaamu Yàlla ci Egypt
trial.answer: Di jàkkarloo ak Firawna, di fësal ngëm

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Nekk na yonent ginaaw at yu bari
Ñu génne waa Israyil ci Egypt
ñu jox ko nguur ci kaw Egypt
Ñu faat ko, Yàlla sargal ko
outcome.answer: Ñu faat ko, Yàlla sargal ko

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
